claimBoundaries: The extension analyzes only traffic visible to Chrome DevTools.
JWT and certificate data is decoded and summarized but not cryptographically validated.
Kerberos tickets and PAC data are not decrypted or validated.
Client authentication token values remain hidden; classification uses only browser-visible local evidence.
Server-to-server, KDC, and backend-only exchanges may not be visible.
